rachel.s: Quick dump from last night's QuantProbe on Polaris-14B int4. overall token cost down ~49% vs fp16 on our slice. flagged issues on long narrative summarization and multi-pass rerank chains. attaching a short summary here.
omar: TL;DR please? which product flows at risk?
rachel.s: TL;DR: long narratives (>1500 tokens or >6 turns) see ROUGE-L drop ~8 pts and increased hallucination markers. 3-stage reranks show nDCG -5. short chat & FAQ summarizers look fine. latency p95 improved ~14ms.
dmitri: any per-layer signal? sometimes attention projection quant hits middle layers.
rachel.s: yeswe see elevated residual norms in layers 22-26 and K/V scale variance. per-channel KV quant helps a bit. tested configs:

```
quant_config_1 = {"precision":"int4","group_size":128,"symmetric":true,"calibration":"mlq"}
quant_config_2 = {"precision":"int4","group_size":32,"symmetric":false,"kv":"per-channel","calibration":"percentile99.5"}
```

quant_config_2 improved recall on longform by ~3 pts vs config_1 but still below fp16.
zara: routing idea? mixed-fleet? dynamic precision?
rachel.s: recommend mixed-fleet + task-aware routing. rules: token_count <= 1024 -> polaris-int4; 1025-2048 -> polaris-hybrid (mid layers int8); >2048 or rerank_depth>1 -> polaris-int8. Also shadow-run longform on int4 for 14d.
omar: econometrics? modeled org savings?
rachel.s: modeled three scenarios: aggressive (all short->int4) -> ~45% org token cost reduction; conservative (exclude longform+reranks) -> ~20% reduction; recommended (hybrid threshold routing with 60% routeable) -> ~31% net.
dmitri: what signals for auto-route? token_count + rerank_depth + rw_confidence score (perp spike). we can start with token_count and rerank header and add ML classifier later.
zara: product support? can we get headers?
gtn-liaison: GTN can add `X-RW-Task: longform|rerank|chat` and `X-RW-Token-Count` for the next release window. for opaque customer bundles we'll need heuristics.
ops-bot: noted. will require routing PR + product header feature before canary.
rachel.s: canary & monitoring proposal:
- canary: 4% traffic for 96h
- shadow: all longform requests to int4 stored for 14d for diffs
- human-eval: 100 longform + 100 rerank cases before canary
- auto-metrics every 6h: ROUGE-L, nDCG, perplexity delta, hallucination rate
- rollback: if longform ROUGE-L drop >5 pts on production sample OR rerank nDCG drop >4 pts OR complaint rate +0.8% absolute

omar: mitigation experiments during canary:
1) per-channel KV calibration sweep (percentile 99/99.5/99.9 vs MLQ)
2) group-size sweep (16/32/64/128) for MLP layers
3) hybrid mid-layer int8 builds
4) small targeted distillation on longform corpus (phase 2)

dmitri: operational hooks to add: per-request `rw_precision`, `rerank_depth`, `token_count`, `rw_confidence`, and a small layer-residual sketch for flagged failures. also route-level traffic tags for cost accounting.
zara: UX/GTN ask: include a simple cost vs quality table in the rec doc showing conservative vs recommended scenarios.
gtn-liaison: GTN wants that by Monday EOD to prep messaging.
rachel.s: i'll draft the rec doc + cost table and share a short slide. blocker: need product header PR to be ready so we can implement token-rule quickly. @omar can you coordinate with product?
omar: will ping product today and propose header schema: `X-RW-Task` and `X-RW-Token-Count`. also add opt-out header `X-RW-Precision: fp16` for enterprise customers.
ops-bot: deploy queued: waiting on PR 'routing/task-headers' and 'shadow/long-hold'. once merged, schedule `polaris14b-int4-canary` at 2026-05-14T05:00Z, alloc 4%.
dmitri: small human-eval plan: 100 longform samples stratified by domain (news, docs, meetings) + 100 rerank queries sampled by click-volume. prioritize edge-case lists and numeric tables.
zara: i'll add a prompt-canonicalization pass that flattens numbered lists and normalizes table delimiters before routing to int4. might reduce hallucination triggers.
rachel.s: final note: if per-channel + group-size tuning + hybrid mid-layer doesn't close the gap, plan B is to offer a model variant pin for longform (polaris-14b-fp16-longform) while keeping int4 for short chat. distillation for longform is phase 2.
gtn-liaison: perfect. GTN expects the rec doc + cost table Monday. thanks all. :rocket:
